votes.motion: Approve the Work Session minutes from January 10, 2023, and the Formal Minutes from January 17, 2023.
votes.description: Approval of prior meeting minutes for the work session held January 10, 2023 and the formal meeting held January 17, 2023.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 11 of 2023, amending the Fiscal Year 2023 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document only for item E-1: Treasure Emergency Rental Assistance Program Additional Resources – $2 Million for Salt Lake City tenant assistance through the Utah Rent Relief Program.
votes.description: Adopts a partial budget amendment for FY2022-23 providing $2 million in additional emergency rental assistance funding for Salt Lake City tenants through the Utah Rent Relief Program.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance amending the Zoning Text pertaining to the use of Landscape Materials to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed zoning amendments related to water-wise landscaping and lawn grass limits, deferring final action to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Ordinance regarding Right of Way Permit Notification Fee to a future date.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on proposed amendments to notice requirements and fees for work-in-the-public-way permits to a future meeting date at staff's request.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance adopting the Glendale Regional Park Plan to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Glendale Regional Park Plan (a specific plan for the 17-acre former Raging Waters site) and defers final adoption to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ordinance adopting the Northpoint Small Area Plan to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Northpoint Small Area Plan, which guides land use and development along the 2200 West corridor between the airport and the city's northern boundary, and defers final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 05 of 2023 to approve participation in the municipal alternative voting methods pilot program for ranked choice voting in the 2023 municipal general election.
votes.description: Authorizes Salt Lake City's participation in the State-authorized ranked choice voting pilot program for the 2023 municipal general election, under which voters rank candidates by preference.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2023 approving American Rescue Plan Act local business assistance grant awards as shown in the Funding Log except for items 2, 5, 7, 17, 27, 35, 37, and 41.
votes.description: Approves ARPA fiscal recovery fund grant awards to local businesses demonstrating pandemic-related economic hardship, excluding specific items requiring separate votes due to conflict-of-interest recusals.

votes.motion: Adopt an ordinance approving American Rescue Plan Act local business assistance grant awards as shown in the Funding Log for items 2, 5, 7, 17, 35, 37, and 41.
votes.description: Approves ARPA local business assistance grant awards for specific funding log items voted separately due to Council Member Valdemoros's recusal from these items.

votes.motion: Adopt an ordinance approving American Rescue Plan Act local business assistance grant awards as shown in the Funding Log for item 27.
votes.description: Approves the ARPA local business assistance grant award for Funding Log item 27, voted separately due to Council Member Petro's recusal from this item.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 06 of 2023 authorizing the approval of an interlocal cooperation agreement between Salt Lake City Corporation and West Valley City regarding the transfer of ownership of a tactical vehicle (MITS) from Salt Lake City Corporation to West Valley City.
votes.description: Approves an interlocal agreement transferring a Mobile Interoperable Tactical Solution Vehicle originally purchased with Urban Areas Security Initiative grant funds from Salt Lake City to West Valley City for regional emergency use.

Approves multiple consent items including setting public hearing dates, confirming a hearing date, approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 5) for FY2022-23, and approving board appointments for Hannah Nielsen (Arts Council), Pamela Silberman (Human Rights Commission), and Will Terry (Human Rights Commission).
